temperature.note: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.28 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; GALAH measured its temperature, so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
